Source: `oomol-lab/skills@4597539`

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@146ef20`

- Initial release of the `oo-jobnimbus` skill for operating JobNimbus through an OOMOL-connected account using the `oo` CLI.
- Supports reading JobNimbus records with actions to get individual contacts and jobs by ID.
- Supports listing contacts and jobs with pagination, sorting, field selection, actor options, and Elasticsearch-style filters.
